items.name: Arizona Quiet Championship 2026
items.information: Arizona's first quiet championship! This is competition will only have quiet events, and will not have the regular 3x3 event. Since this is a quiet competition, spectators and competitors are expected to be quiet and minimize noise during events. ### Please note that competitors are limited to 1 guest each. This is due to venue space and limited seating available. ### Arizona's state championship will be held right before this competition (Jan 17-18), in Tempe, and will have all other events. Online registration closes 1/10/26 at 5 PM MST. Register [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArizonaChampionship2026) for Arizona Championship. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArizonaQuietChampionship2026#67866-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab. ### Connect with the Arizona cubing community! Instagram: [@arizonacubing](https://www.instagram.com/arizonacubing/) Facebook Group: [Arizona Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/arizonacubing)
